title: One state of everything, so no count is ever wrong again

chat.text: You asked for one coherent data structure over the sessions store and the module task homes that represents the current state of everything, rock solid, for a UI or a model alike. Tonight the tasks dashboard showed 0 landed today while 27 had landed, because it read a different reader over a different slice of the store. The dashboard is fixed to a seven-day window from the whole store, and an Opus task mastermind is building the one State class with self-checks that fail loudly. Plan: /framework/ai/doc/one-state.md
